kpi.fidelity.help.en: Mean |transfer gap| across models (points); lower is better. Rank correlation shown from 5 models.

kpi.hours.help.en: Hours from model API availability to leaderboard publication; target ≤48h, hard line 72h.

kpi.human.help.zh: 本期全部人工操作时长（场地、真机、剪辑、发布）。
kpi.human.help.en: Total hands-on time this edition (arena, robot, editing, publishing).

kpi.cost.help.zh: 仿真与真机全部模型调用的美元总额（按官网单价；人民币按协议汇率 ¥7.1/$ 换算并列于榜单）。
kpi.cost.help.en: USD total of all model calls, sim and real (list prices; CNY shown alongside at the protocol rate of ¥7.1/$).

board.sub.zh: 仿真分∈[0,1]＝到达检查点占比 − 封顶的碰撞事件扣分（协议 §5）；真机分同式。迁移差＝真机分 − 仿真分，为头条指标。行名＝模型 ID · 思考档 · 端点（配置即身份，改任一项＝新行）；「已复跑」＝操作方复跑过，「自报」＝投稿方自报。只列模型；读真值的基线与天花板见下。 真机列：待锚（第二期）——目标窗 11 月底～12 月初，11-02 定日；公开征集＝仿真按协议复跑（protocol-v0-prereg）＋真机复跑意向登记，真机协议 v0 第二期前发布。
board.sub.en: Sim score ∈ [0,1] = share of checkpoints reached − capped collision-event penalty (protocol §5); real score uses the same formula. Transfer gap = real − sim, the headline metric. Row = model ID · thinking mode · endpoint (configuration is identity: change any and it is a new row); “re-run” = re-run by the operator, “self-reported” = submitted as is. Models only; ground-truth baselines and ceiling below. Real-robot column: anchor pending (Edition 02) — target window late Nov to early Dec, date set on 11-02; open call = sim re-runs under the protocol (protocol-v0-prereg) + registration of intent for real-robot re-runs; the real-robot protocol v0 is published before Edition 02.

board.empty.zh: 本期尚未发布：仿真列由 episodes/ 下的 CSV 自动填入；真机列待锚（第二期）。
board.empty.en: Not published yet: the sim column fills automatically from episodes/ CSVs; the real-robot column is anchor-pending (Edition 02).

kind.astar.zh: 天花板（已知地图 A*，读真值）
kind.astar.en: Ceiling (A* on known map, ground truth)

kind.greedy.zh: 基线（贪心真值导航，读真值）

baseline.h.zh: 基线与天花板（读真值·非视觉；仿真，成本 0，不进榜）
baseline.h.en: Baselines & ceiling (ground truth, non-visual; sim, zero cost, not ranked)

baseline.sub.zh: 同一组种子上的脚本化对照，与模型行分栏：astar／greedy 读孪生真值（位姿、地图），不看相机图；模型成绩应落在 random 与 astar 之间。 三行为预注册基线数据（非新跑，tag protocol-v0-prereg 内基线批）；另一行「附真值提示」（诊断跑批：三家各 N=10、每步附 A* 下一步动作文本，各 10/10、碰撞 0）同列于此，不进模型榜。
baseline.sub.en: Scripted references on the same seeds, kept apart from model rows: astar/greedy read the twin's ground truth (pose, map) and never see the camera; model scores should fall between random and astar. The three rows are pre-registered baseline data (no new runs; the baseline batch inside tag protocol-v0-prereg); one more row, "ground-truth hint" (diagnostic batch: each of the three models, N=10, with the A* next action appended to every step's prompt — 10/10 each, zero collisions), sits in this column and stays out of the model board.

method.score.v.zh: 仿真分＝max(0, 到达检查点数/5 − min(0.1 × 碰撞起始事件数, 0.5))，N 回合算术平均并附 95% 置信半宽；到达半径 0.40 m；回合上限 80 步。全文见协议 §5，计分只在 harness/scoring.py 实现。
method.score.v.en: Sim score = max(0, checkpoints reached/5 − min(0.1 × collision-onset events, 0.5)), averaged over N episodes with a 95% CI half-width; reach radius 0.40 m; 80-step cap. See protocol §5; scoring is implemented once, in harness/scoring.py.

method.gap.v.zh: 迁移差＝真机分 − 仿真分（同一模型、同一组种子）；保真度＝各模型 |迁移差| 均值；只在每期真机后升版孪生，每次只修迁移差最大一项。
method.gap.v.en: Gap = real − sim (same model, same seeds); fidelity = mean |gap|; the twin is revised only after each real-robot edition, fixing the single largest gap.

method.en.zh: English（流水线生成·便利译本，中文为准）
